title: The Order of Salvation
definition: The Order of Salvation describes the connected biblical truths by which God applies redemption to His people from calling to glory.
summary: The Order of Salvation helps explain the biblical relationships among God's saving acts, from calling to glorification.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the foundation and goal of every saving blessing, from election to glorification.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine does not reduce salvation to a mechanical chart. It helps the Church understand how God's saving work is connected: election, calling, regeneration, faith, justification, adoption, sanctification, perseverance, and glorification. It brings clarity without removing mystery or worship.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because confusion about one part of salvation often affects the rest. The order of salvation protects assurance, doctrine, and discipleship by showing that God's work is coherent and complete. It helps believers see that salvation is not fragile or random.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Use this doctrine as a map for worship, not as a weapon for pride. Trace your salvation back to God's mercy and forward to His promised completion. Let clarity deepen gratitude and patience with others.
